guide.summary: History museums, galleries, gardens and family outings, with breakfast spots, bakeries, dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Watch the early-week schedules: the Apartheid Museum opens Tuesday to Sunday, Montecasino Bird Gardens opens Wednesday to Sunday, and Gold Reef City Theme Park is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays except during school or public holidays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Apartheid Museum opens Tuesday to Sunday, Montecasino Bird Gardens opens Wednesday to Sunday, and Gold Reef City Theme Park is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays except during school or public holidays. Origins Centre is closed on Sundays, and Wits Art Museum opens Tuesday to Saturday and closes on public holidays.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.value: Arrive before 16h00 and carry a card
toolkit.copy: Constitution Hill sells no tickets after 16h00 and runs a cashless ticket desk, and Johannesburg Zoo has last entry at 4:00 pm and takes card only at the gate from 1 December 2026. Walter Sisulu National Botanical Garden no longer accepts cash.

toolkit.label: Booking
toolkit.copy: Marble says a reservation is essential, and Obscura asks for a R200 per head deposit for tables of six or more. Doppio Zero (Rosebank) takes Dineplan bookings at least 24 hours ahead and holds a table for 30 minutes.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.value: Age guidance, ID and park rules
toolkit.copy: The Apartheid Museum says it is not suitable for children under 11, and Constitution Hill requires under-12s to be with an adult. The Johannesburg Holocaust & Genocide Centre requires ID for entry, and the Johannesburg Botanical Garden bans alcohol and braais.

guide.dek: Plan sights around early-week closures and book Rosebank dinner tables before you go.
intro: Johannesburg's recent history is told most directly in its museums. The Apartheid Museum in Ormonde opens Tuesday to Sunday, 09:00 to 17:00, and on most public holidays; it suggests about two hours for a visit and says it is not suitable for children under 11. Constitution Hill at 11 Kotze Street is open 9am to 5pm daily, with a one-hour highlights tour every hour until 16h00 and two-hour full site tours at 10h00 and 13h00. In Soweto, Mandela House at 8115 Vilakazi Street publishes separate local and international ticket prices.

For deeper history and art, the Origins Centre at Wits in Braamfontein opens Monday to Friday from 09H00 to 17H00 and Saturdays and public holidays from 09H00 to 16H00, and is closed on Sundays; adult entry is R95. Wits Art Museum opens Tuesday to Saturday, 10:00 to 16:00, and lists Nature's Elements among its current shows. Liliesleaf in Rivonia opens Monday to Friday, 09h00 to 16h00, with weekend and holiday visits by prior booking. The Johannesburg Holocaust & Genocide Centre in Forest Town is free but asks you to bring ID.

With children, Johannesburg Zoo in Parkview is open every day with last entry at 4:00 pm, and takes card only at the gate from 1 December 2026. Montecasino Bird Gardens in Fourways opens Wednesday to Sunday, 09h00 to 17h00, with bird demonstrations at 11:00 and 15:00, weather permitting. Gold Reef City Theme Park is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays except during school or public holidays, and admits no one after 16h00. For open space, the Johannesburg Botanical Garden is open from sunrise to sunset, and Walter Sisulu National Botanical Garden opens daily from 08h00 to 17h00.

Rosebank anchors the eating and drinking. Proud Mary at 26 Cradock Avenue is open daily from 06h30 to 24h00 for breakfast, lunch and dinner, and Fournos on Baker Street opens at 06h00 on weekdays. Marble, on Keyes Avenue, serves lunch from 12pm to 4pm and dinner from 5pm to 10pm, and says a reservation is essential. For cocktails, Mix Cocktail Bar on Keyes Avenue opens Tuesday to Friday from 4pm and Saturday from 11am, while Obscura on Oxford Road opens Tuesday to Sunday from 12pm to 12am.
summaryCards: Pair the Apartheid Museum, open Tuesday to Sunday, with Constitution Hill, which runs hourly highlights tours until 16h00.
Start with breakfast at Proud Mary, open daily from 06h30, then walk the Johannesburg Botanical Garden, open from sunrise to sunset.
Reserve Marble ahead, and remember Montecasino Bird Gardens opens Wednesday to Sunday while Gold Reef City Theme Park is closed on Mondays and Tuesdays outside school and public holidays.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several confirmed places show only a 2026 copyright footer, menu file or booking policy as evidence of operation (Marble, Saint, Mix Cocktail Bar, Obscura, Bean There, Sakhumzi, Liliesleaf, Ditsong Military History, Everard Read), so they are rated medium. Hours were not published on the pages read for Mandela House, Everard Read, Bean There and Sakhumzi (buffet times only), and Gold Reef City Theme Park gives no daily hours; its address is taken from Tsogo Sun's Gold Reef City complex page. Johannesburg Zoo's visit page gives an 8:30 am opening while its fee page gives 8:00 am. Sites that could not be read: Four Seasons The Westcliff and Nelson Mandela Square (403), Victoria Yards events (403), Father Coffee and DW Eleven-13 (404), The Marabi Club (500), Kitchener's and Orlando Towers (connection refused), Sin + Tax, Doubleshot and Home of the Bean (DNS failure), Les Créatifs (SSL error). No food market could be confirmed. A first automated read of the Apartheid Museum visitor-information page reported text addressed to an AI, but a second read found none and no wording could be quoted, so nothing is listed under injectionLikeText.

injectionLikeTextIgnored.note: 2026-11-20: the reviewer's first WebFetch read reported text addressed to an AI, which a second read did not reproduce. Loaded the page in the in-app browser and searched the full HTML (69,708 characters) for AI, assistant, LLM, model names and "ignore instructions" phrases. The only matches were inside the Facebook pixel script, so the flag was false.
